:::{#def-positive-agreement}
#### Positive agreement

The **positive agreement**
(also called the *average positive agreement*)
of an agreement table (@def-agreement-table)
is the number of positive calls the agent and the reference share,
counted once for each classifier,
as a proportion of all their positive calls:

$$p_{\text{pos}} \eqdef \frac{2a}{2a + b + c}$$

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
#### Source

@cicchetti1990high.
